seeds.derivation: dispersed = 200000 + (first 32 bits of sha256('rule-sabotage/v5.3/dispersed-seed/' + i) mod 3999000000), i = 0..14
seeds.design: the same 30 seeds for every policy, each with both first movers (mirrored): 60 self-play games per policy, 180 total, no cross-play

limits.reruns: none, not even for failed or timed-out games

censoring: A game stopped by the 30-minute limit is ABORTED (censored), not a draw: excluded from win rates, counted separately, and win-rate sensitivity bounds are reported (all aborted games counted as first-mover wins / as first-mover losses).

hypotheses.P1: Policy dependence of the first-mover rate: at least one pairwise difference between policies (paired by seed, seed-blocked 95%) excludes 0.
hypotheses.P2: Rule robustness of a first-mover edge across eligible policies (verdict rule below); INSUFFICIENT POLICIES with fewer than 2 eligible.
hypotheses.P3: Descriptive: Human-side rate, length, turn-limit rate, turn-2 captures, strategic vs RNG diversity, conditional decisions, compute.

eligibility: replay OK for every game of the policy, 0 illegal moves, 0 engine errors other than the time limit, plan/execution agreement 1.0 (corrected metric), at most 3 of 60 games aborted

decisionRules.policyDependence: POLICY-DEPENDENT if a paired seed-blocked 95% interval of a pairwise first-mover difference excludes 0
decisionRules.ruleRobustness: edge = first-mover rate - 0.5 per eligible policy (seed-blocked): ROBUST ACROSS THE ELIGIBLE POLICIES if all lie beyond +0.05 (or all beyond -0.05); POLICY-DEPENDENT if one lies beyond 0.05 and another within +-0.05 or beyond on the other side; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise; INSUFFICIENT POLICIES with fewer than 2 eligible. Never a proof about the rules.
decisionRules.stop: If the preflight fails, no game is played. During the run nothing is stopped or rerun.

distinguish: gameplay quality for humans (not measurable by self-play)
